From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call: book technical deep-dive + infra attendee list

Hi Sanjay / Priya — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the 60–90min TDX with the right folks from both sides.

Recap (1 line): Stellar Data wants to validate inference latency at 95th pct, discuss token economics at scale, and review data controls for PII-sensitive logs.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (TDX) with Redwood ML/infra + Stellar engineering. Goals: live walkthrough of serving/runtime choices, perf numbers for your workload pattern, and an action plan for a pilot.

Two candidate windows (all PST):
- Tue 29 Nov — 10:00–11:30
- Wed 1 Dec — 16:00–17:30

Can you confirm which works? If neither, please propose two alternatives. Also useful: who from your side should attend (engineers / security / infra) so we can invite the correct Redwood roster.

Attached: TDX_Agenda_v1.pdf — high-level agenda + prep asks.

Marissa / Vivek — looping you in to check availability and to confirm we’re aligned on proposed scope (quantization/testing plan, KV caching behavior, and SLOs).

Thanks,

--
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: TDX_Agenda_v1.pdf (1 page agenda — attendees, goals, pre-reads)

Thanks David — appreciated the summary. Wed 1 Dec 16:00–17:30 PST looks best for us.

Attendees from Stellar Data:
- Sanjay Rao — Head of Applied ML (will lead)
- Priya Desai — Engineering manager (integration lead)
- Alan Chu — Platform engineer (attending)

A couple quick asks before the TDX:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood’s KV cache is persisted between warmups for long-running sessions? We have stateful usage patterns and need to understand warm start behavior.
2) Can Marissa/Vivek share any pre-read material on quantization/throughput tradeoffs?

I’ve added Priya on the thread. We’re comfortable with the attached agenda — feel free to update if needed.

Sanjay
